description: 框线板与大板双版型整墙定制，客厅卧室背景墙一体成型

palette.name: 石墨文字与信息带（基础）

styleLock.backgroundSystem: 两套背景严格交替：雾白实景墙 #F5F4F1（始终含踢脚与顶面阴影缝，见得到墙的全高）与平面浅石灰信息底板 #E4E2DC；石墨带 #3D4249 只允许用于标题条与流程时间轴，禁止随机换景、禁止户外与纯色渐变背景
styleLock.lightingSystem: 单一大型漫射 5000K 正面日光，墙面自上而下渐进衰减，无方向性日光带、无暖光滤镜；仅微距与剖切镜头允许加一道低角度 5000K 掠光揭示线脚凹凸；接触阴影必须真实存在，所有竖线与拼缝保持真正垂直
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 墙板主体哑光灰泥白 #D9D2C6 配框线 #E6E1D8、鼠尾草岩纹大板 #8E958C、竖向格栅燕麦板 #CFC5B4、织物夹芯板 #B9C0B4、浅灰金属收边条 #A9A6A0，地面为哑光石灰石 #DDD9D2，信息画面为平整浅石灰板 #E4E2DC
styleLock.typography: 现代几何无衬线中文单一家族，只用 light 与 regular 字重并加宽字距；标题两行制，下方一道松绿细强调线 #2F5A4A；标签 12-14 单位，所有画面内文字一律以占位符呈现，禁止复刻源文案
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.2 单位细线单色图标 #3D4249，方切端点，配 1px 描边胶囊标签；禁止填充色块图标、禁止等轴测插画、禁止立体徽章
styleLock.presentationRules: 护墙板永远以全高呈现（地面到顶面阴影缝），版型节奏、框线线脚轮廓、拼缝开槽宽度与夹芯材质在整套内保持一致；实景镜头必须有真实家具（沙发/床/悬浮柜）作为尺度锚点，透视竖线校正；电视与柜体不得遮挡主拼缝；人物若出现只允许裁切的匿名局部，永不露脸
noDrift: no brand marks or supplier names
no invented board grades, thickness, dimensions, certifications or price figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium architectural whole-home wall-paneling ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist-white room-build wall #F5F4F1, flat pale limestone info board #E4E2DC, graphite type and band #3D4249, oat panel body #CFC5B4 and one accent pine green #2F5A4A; neutral tone throughout with no warm filters and no colour casts; background system alternates only the mist-white full-height room-build wall #F5F4F1 and the flat pale limestone board #E4E2DC, with the graphite band #3D4249 reserved for headline strips and the process timeline; lighting system is one large soft diffused 5000K frontal daylight source with a gentle top-to-bottom falloff, no directional sun band, one low raking 5000K fill allowed only on macro and section screens, honest contact shadows, corrected verticals and true 90-degree corners; surface system is matte putty-white panel body #D9D2C6 with frame mouldings #E6E1D8, sage stone-look slab #8E958C, fluted oat panel #CFC5B4, fabric insert board #B9C0B4 and pale grey metal trim #A9A6A0 over a limestone floor #DDD9D2; typography is one modern geometric sans-serif family used only at light and regular weights with wide letter spacing, two-line headline, one hairline accent rule in #2F5A4A and 1px outlined pill tags; layout system uses sharp right-angle frames, hairline leader lines and small numbered circles, never rounded frosted cards; icon system is 1.2-unit hairline single-line icons in #3D4249 with square-cut ends, no filled icons, no isometric illustration; panelling is always shown full height from floor to ceiling shadow-gap with panel rhythm, moulding profile, joint reveals and insert material held constant across the set, every scene anchored by a real furnishing for scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no invented material grades or dimensions.

Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Purpose: present the range so choosing feels like picking a swatch, not gambling. Composition: a 2x3 grid on one panel, each cell photographed straight-on at the identical height and crop showing the same wall segment and the same panel rhythm: putty-white frame panel #E3DCD0, oat fluted panel #CFC5B4, sage stone-look slab #8E958C, warm sand linen panel #C8B49A, slate greige panel #9B9C9A and deep pine panel #2F5A4A. Lighting: identical soft 5000K frontal daylight in all six cells with matched falloff and matched contact shadows, zero light drift between cells. Background: each cell standing on mist-white ground #F5F4F1 with thin pale limestone gutters #E4E2DC. Layout: a headline row reading 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top in #3D4249 and one short spec pill under each cell reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」, 「{callout_5}」, 「{callout_6}」. Wall segments occupy 70-80% of frame overall. Negative: no mixed lighting between cells, no resized cells, no invented SKU codes, no price tags, no brand marks, no faces, no extra text, no watermark, no pattern repetition artefacts.

shots.intent: 以可核验的服务节点消除大额定制交易的决策风险。
shots.camera: flat straight-on infographic screen, a small wall vignette at the lower left, five-node horizontal timeline across the upper half
shots.lighting: even high-key 5000K frontal light, shadowless card surfaces, one soft contact shadow grounding the vignette
shots.background: flat pale limestone info board #E4E2DC with one graphite headline band #3D4249
shots.props: five hairline step icons and three short payment stage blocks #F5F4F1, no certificates, no seals
shots.textZone: 石墨带内标题「{selling_point_1}」，五个节点标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_5}」，三段付款块「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and process screen of {product}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Purpose: remove risk in a high-value custom purchase by laying out the service path and the staged settlement, not by asserting authority. Composition: flat straight-on layout on a pale limestone info board #E4E2DC, a graphite headline band #3D4249 across the top, a five-node numbered timeline in the upper half with square-cut hairline icons in #3D4249 marking online booking, on-site measuring, plan design, sample confirmation and contract signing, three short payment stage blocks in mist white #F5F4F1 below them, and a small full-height wall vignette of {product} placed at the lower left. Lighting: even high-key 5000K frontal light, shadowless card surfaces, one soft contact shadow under the vignette. Layout: headline inside the graphite band reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in #F5F4F1, five node labels reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」, 「{callout_5}」 and three stage labels reading 「{callout_6}」, 「{callout_7}」, 「{callout_8}」 in #3D4249 with hairline dividers. Product occupies 40-50% of frame. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, lab tests, material grades, supplier names, service-city lists, delivery dates or years of warranty, no monetary amounts, no percentages, no per-square-metre prices, no QR codes, no membership badges, no brand marks, no dense small print, no watermark.

shots.intent: 收口引导买家提交墙面尺寸并发起量房咨询。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at standing eye level, wall segment centred low in frame, full height visible, verticals corrected
shots.lighting: soft 5000K frontal daylight from the left with one low raking fill along the moulding edges, deep honest contact shadow at the base
shots.background: mist-white room-build wall #F5F4F1 with one oversized graphite panel block #3D4249 behind the wall segment
shots.props: one floating console #DCCDB4, one folded greige textile #B9B6AE on it, nothing over the joint reveals
shots.whitespace: upper headline band and lower button band
shots.textZone: 顶部两行标题「{selling_point_1}」，底部 1px 描边矩形按钮「{callout_1}」，按钮上方一行小字「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing call-to-action screen of {product}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Purpose: convert attention into one low-friction action, booking an on-site wall measure. Composition: the panelled wall segment centred in the lower two thirds, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle from standing eye level, full height from floor to ceiling reveal visible and verticals corrected, an oversized graphite panel block #3D4249 placed behind it on the mist-white room-build wall #F5F4F1 to frame the silhouette. Lighting: soft 5000K frontal daylight from the left with one low raking fill running along the frame mouldings #E6E1D8 on panel body #D9D2C6, deep honest contact shadow at the base on limestone floor #DDD9D2. Props: one floating console #DCCDB4 with one folded greige textile #B9B6AE, nothing covering a joint reveal. Product occupies 45-55% of frame. Layout: two-line headline at the top reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in #3D4249, one 1px outlined rectangular button near the bottom reading 「{callout_1}」 and one short line above the button reading 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no invented discounts, no countdown timers, no price numbers, no coupon bursts, no membership badges, no QR codes, no brand marks, no people, no faces, no extra text, no watermark, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 7 张详情页切片 + 1 张整页缩略图逐片判读，合并为 12 镜。本套为「全屋家装定制」系列页 #1（#2、#3 已分别转化为布艺沙发与 L 型转角沙发），故本页主体不再取沙发：页面反复出现的真实拍摄主体是客厅电视背景墙与卧室床头背景墙的整墙定制护墙板系统（框线板 + 夹芯板、岩纹大板带竖向拼缝、竖向格栅板、悬浮电视柜与顶面阴影缝），属墙板/背景墙面材，因此 L1 判为家装灯具、L2 判为建材、leaf 为全屋定制集成护墙板电视背景墙；未判家具家纺，因主体为墙面饰板系统而非柜体或坐具。已剥离：原图全部标题与副文案（含「全屋家装定制」「专业家装设计师一对一服务」「整体规划」「效果更佳」「定制整装·详细流程」「分段式付款流程」「预约人气设计师」「装修案例展示」「六大潮流风格家具」「千图设计全国服务」「加入会员 全店免费」等）、品牌角标「千图装饰」与全部二维码、五个流程步骤原文、分段付款 50%/40%/10% 比例、两级设计费 68/88/118/168/128/178 元每平方米价目、案例房间标签「客厅」「卧室」、等轴测飞机与地图插画；未编造任何板材等级（E0/ENF）、厚度、五金品牌、质保年限、每平方米报价、填充密度或认证，相关处一律以 {callout_*} / {selling_point_*} 占位。差异化：与库内北欧布艺沙发（6500K 灰蓝北向光）、灰蓝布艺转角沙发（4000-4300K 板岩灰 + 炭黑带 + 重黑体）、木饰面板（暗黄铜）、意式风书柜（墨板岩 + 橡木）、开放式金属衣柜（暖抹灰墙 + 橡木 + 焦糖 + 侧向窗光带）全部区隔，本套锁定中性 5000K 大面积漫射正面日光（无日光带、仅微距与剖切用低掠光）、雾白实景墙 #F5F4F1 + 浅石灰信息底 #E4E2DC + 石墨带 #3D4249 + 松绿强调 #2F5A4A、light/regular 宽字距几何无衬线、1px 描边胶囊与方切细线图标、直角版面（禁用圆角磨砂卡）。所有实景镜头竖线校正并以沙发/床/悬浮柜等真实家具锚定尺度；人物统一禁用或仅允许裁切匿名局部。{style_lock} 在生成时逐字展开为 styleLock.lockText；每镜均内嵌原文产品保真锁与末尾 Negative 清单，版型节奏、框线线脚轮廓、拼缝开槽、夹芯材质与饰面颜色按参考图保持一致。
